fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: The normalized event timestamp in UTC.
fields.justification: Needed to determine when an event occurred and correlate activity across sources.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: The hostname associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify which system generated or observed the event.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: The type of source that produced the normalized event.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish Windows, Linux, and network telemetry during analysis.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: A high-level classification of the event.
fields.justification: Needed to group events into meaningful categories for detection and triage.

source_mapping.network: derived from event_type or source file

fields.name: severity
fields.description: The normalized severity level assigned to the event.
fields.justification: Needed to prioritize potentially important events during investigation.

fields.name: user
fields.description: The user account associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to determine which account performed or was affected by an activity.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: The process associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify which process generated or performed the activity.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: The source IP address associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the originating network endpoint and correlate network activity.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: The destination IP address associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the destination network endpoint involved in an event.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.justification: Needed to preserve source evidence for validation and detailed investigation.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: The source network port associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the originating network service or connection endpoint.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: The destination network port associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the destination service or connection endpoint.
